items.rationale: A fixed, pre-existing kitchen AC is a building component under §4.2.2, and this wording has no kitchen-specific exclusion. The €1,413 estimate is for one equivalent replacement under §§7.1.9–7.1.10, conditional on confirmation that atmospheric electricity caused the surge and that fire-group cover was in force (§§2.2–2.3.3).

Under §§7.1.11 and 9.5, necessary installation is payable only to the extent it can be allocated to a covered replacement. The €480 estimate is for one ordinary installation and excludes any separate wiring check or work on unrelated equipment.

An existing console mount is reported, but the claim does not establish that the console was damaged or could not be reused. Under §§7.1.5 and 7.1.9–7.1.11, €61 is the estimate for one equivalent console if replacement was necessary to reinstate a covered unit.

Ordinary freight follows the covered replacement under §7.1.11 and is not a separate expense under Part 5. The €43 estimate is for one ordinary shipment attributable to the covered AC; any freight for unrelated equipment must be separated.
